description.value: D'oro Gelato e Caffè on Robson Street is a long-established Italian artisan gelateria and full-service café in the heart of downtown Vancouver, producing small-batch homemade gelato and sorbetto alongside Italian pastries baked fresh each morning, grilled panini, and seasonal soups and salads. Operating for nearly two decades and recognized with an Ospitalità Italiana endorsement from the Italian government, the café offers both indoor and outdoor seating on the busy Robson Street shopping corridor. Touring cyclists can fuel up with a full meal, a sweet treat, or artisan Caffè Umbria espresso at a single stop.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces, covered) at 28m; stands (2 spaces) at 41m; stands (4 spaces) at 73m; stands (6 spaces) at 96m. Total: 22 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the address (1222 Robson Street, Vancouver, BC V6E 1C1), phone (604-694-0108), and that the business is actively operating. Takeout is confirmed via explicit mentions of online ordering and Uber Eats on the menu subpage; dairy-free sorbetto is explicitly called out for non-dairy customers, supporting a vegan/vegetarian option. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or most other amenity fields appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, well-established full-service café in a prime downtown Vancouver cycling corridor, but none of the required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from website or OSM evidence; on-site verification is needed before listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Sorbetto explicitly described as a 'dairy-free alternative' to gelato; menu includes salads and vegetarian-compatible Italian items
